:::{#lem-estimation-error-bound}
#### Chance of a large estimation error

If $\hparam$ is an estimator of $\param$ with finite mean squared error,
then for every $\varepsilon > 0$ the probability of an estimation error
of at least $\varepsilon$ is at most the mean squared error
divided by $\varepsilon^2$:

$$
\Prf{\abs{\hparam - \param} \ge \varepsilon} \le \frac{\mselr{\hparam}}{\varepsilon^2}
$$ {#eq-estimation-error-bound}

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-estimation-error-bound.

:::
